quotes.text: Your AI agents are extensions of the user identity, not separate beings with guardrails. They borrow your access token and run around your data estate, doing precisely what you told them not to
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains in one image why agents inherit user permissions and need guardrails.

quotes.text: DLP doesn't automatically apply across every layer. It has to be scoped, enforced, and tested per environment.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Corrects the common assumption that tenant DLP automatically covers every environment.

quotes.text: entra alone does not secure your agents, it authenticates them politely, efficiently, and indifferently. Security is the architecture wrapped around identity, not the existence of it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Distinguishes authentication from actual security architecture.

quotes.text: A copilot agent is only as trustworthy as its DLP configuration, nothing more. Security through optimism is not a strategy.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Memorable summary of the episode's core argument.

quotes.text: Think of DLP as intellectual containment, not bureaucracy, a set of digital walls keeping intelligence from mutating into exposure.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes DLP as a protective design element rather than red tape.

Entra permissions and the myth of safety

takeaways: Copilot Studio agents run with the delegated permissions of the user, so anything the user can see the agent can retrieve and summarize.
Power Platform DLP policies are environment scoped, so every environment hosting agents needs deliberate business, non-business and blocked connector classifications.
Red-team agents with forbidden prompts, monitor connector analytics and audit logs, and reclassify connectors regularly to prove the setup holds.
hook: Copilot Studio agents inherit your permissions and can quietly pull confidential data through connectors if DLP is not scoped correctly. This episode is for Power Platform and Microsoft 365 admins who want to classify connectors, restrict agent permissions in Entra ID and test and monitor their environments so AI agents stop leaking internal data.
